stem.en: A hypothesis test gives p = 0.12, above the chosen significance level of 0.05. What is the correct conclusion?
stem.et: Hüpoteesi kontroll annab p = 0,12, mis on üle valitud olulisusnivoo 0,05. Milline on õige järeldus?

label.en: The data do not provide enough evidence to reject the null hypothesis
label.et: Andmed ei annanud piisavalt tõendeid nullhüpoteesi tagasilükkamiseks

label.en: The null hypothesis has been proven true
There is a 12% probability that the null hypothesis is true
label.et: On 12% tõenäosus, et nullhüpotees on tõene

label.en: The test should be redone at significance level 0.20 instead, since a stricter level like 0.05 only makes tests needlessly hard to pass
label.et: Test tuleks selle asemel korrata olulisusnivool 0,20, kuna karmim nivoo (nagu 0,05) muudab testi läbimise ainult asjatult raskeks
